crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Broad, trapezoidal rufous patch covering the posterior neck region, showing high contrast against the adjacent crown plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct linear boundary separating the grey crown from the rufous nape and upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark, high-contrast facial mask or streaking visible in the ocular region against lighter facial plumage.
